### Are You Thirsty for God?
Author: Sarah Frazer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/are-you-thirsty-for-god-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Psalm 63:1
Points:
- Daily busyness and good responsibilities can easily distract us from noticing our soul's spiritual thirst.
- When facing isolating wilderness seasons, the heart is often tempted to fill the void with lesser things.
- David responded to danger and loneliness by seeking God first before turning to other sources of help.
- Spending regular time in Scripture and prayer increases our longing to drink deeply from God's goodness.

### My Soul Thirsts for You
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/my-soul-thirsts-for-you
Passage: Psalm 63:1
Points:
- Genuine thirst cuts through distractions and creates an urgent desire that only water can satisfy.
- God allows dry and barren seasons so our experienced lack will drive us to seek Him earnestly.
- Ease and abundance often dull spiritual appetite and entice us to pursue sinful substitutes.
- Outward religious duties and discipline cannot substitute for an authentic, inward craving for God.
- Tasting God's steadfast love reveals that knowing Him is better than earthly life itself.
